headline: SEVENTEEN's Jeonghan teams up with Yamada Ryosuke

info.title: At a glance
rows: Both on Fuji TV 'FNS Kayosai', Dec 9

points.title: What to know
items: Yamada proposed the duet after watching Jeonghan
Jeonghan's first FNS stage in about 2.5 years
Follows his Japan collab 'Better Half' with Omoinotake

source: Source: PLEDIS Entertainment, via Korean media
caption:
SEVENTEEN's Jeonghan is teaming up with Japanese star Yamada Ryosuke for a duet! 🤝

According to PLEDIS Entertainment, the two will release 'Afterglow' on Dec 14. Yamada, who has long wanted to work with overseas artists, proposed the collaboration after watching Jeonghan's activities. Both will also appear on Fuji TV's '2026 FNS Kayosai' on Dec 9, Jeonghan's first time on that stage in about 2 years and 5 months.

📌 Source: PLEDIS Entertainment, via Korean media (Newsen, Sports World)
